snippet.title: Bootstrap Island Major Update 1.1.0 | Steam VR
snippet.description:
The first major post-launch update introduces a brand-new cumulative progression system, the Crate early-game inventory, dangerous Night Apes, full bHaptics support, and numerous gameplay improvements designed to make survival more rewarding and immersive than ever before.

Bootstrap Island is a Robinson Crusoe–inspired VR roguelike survival adventure set in the 17th century. Shipwrecked on a ruthless tropical island, you must survive without guidance. Trust your instincts as you face wild beasts, nature’s fury, and a mysterious local tribe.

Join the adventure:
🌴 Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1942110/Bootstrap_Island/
🔥 Discord: https://discord.com/invite/x48uSXbUyv 
😎 Merch Store: https://www.bootstrapisland.com/store
#pcvr  #VR #survival
